render_inspection: Actual 9 final clay renders, 4 existing-color Eevee renders and 9 matching Cycle03 clay renders visually inspected.
score_semantics: 0 reject, 1 revise, 2 candidate; judgments from actual images, not automatic approval.
hard_rejects: Visible exposed scalp inherited from baseline

acceptance.fabric_thickness_and_overlap: PARTIAL: cuff thickness and crossed collar readable; waist overlap fails
acceptance.shoulder_to_sleeve_continuity: IMPROVED: both sleeves share torso root vertices; small shoulder ridges remain
acceptance.plausible_folds_and_volume: PARTIAL: broad cloth masses, sparse folds, frozen drape
acceptance.no_obvious_mesh_intersections: FAIL: visible torso/sash overlap; hair proximity also remains
acceptance.basic_arm_deformation: PARTIAL: no gross detachment/collapse in two arm tests, rounded underarm bags; no motion or collision certification

issues.region: Top corners of front sash; side and rear waist
issues.observation: Cream torso surface visibly occludes/cuts into burgundy sash at both upper corners. Rear seam also has angular breaks. Earlier legacy skirt sawtooth was reduced, but waist overlap is not resolved.
issues.next_action: Reconcile torso/sash cross-sections and inspect front, side and back with color plus clay before any approval.

issues.region: Temple and crown on character left; side/back head
issues.observation: Exposed dark scalp cap and detached/angular hair strips remain exactly as in Cycle03. Hair geometry was preserved, not repaired by garment integration.
issues.next_action: Separate scoped hair/scalp repair against reference with mesh and shape-key protection.

issues.observation: Collar nape projects as a stiff small shelf; shoulder has rounded bulges and limited cloth tension detail.
issues.next_action: Review nape fit and motivated shoulder folds on full avatar.

issues.observation: Long sleeves are hollow and continuous but very smooth at rest. Raised underarm forms broad rounded bags; folds do not recompute under gravity. Back and long skirt still have large nearly flat areas.
issues.next_action: Refine a few folds driven by seam, gravity and pose; retain silhouette and test motion.

issues.region: Outfit layers, full lower body, footwear
issues.observation: Cream/burgundy palette and long wide sleeves are readable. Separate long haori lapels and other concept motifs are not complete. Lower A-line robe is inferred from an upper-body-only reference; existing sneaker shoes are retained. This is not a faithful finished concept recreation.
issues.next_action: Human review of full silhouette and inferred lower design before accessories/material development.
